title: Stillwater Aquarium
summary: Watch neon tetras dart through a sunlit freshwater tank. Add fish from five species and tap the gravel to clear the water before it grows too murky for them to survive.
summaryZhTW: 看霓虹燈魚在陽光灑落的淡水缸裡穿梭。從五種淡水魚中挑選新住客，輕點底砂吸走汙物，讓魚群在清澈的水中生活。
coverAlt: A striped angelfish and a school of neon tetras swim above driftwood. The title Stillwater Aquarium appears in cream at the lower left.
controls: Select a species to add a fish. Click or tap the water to clean it for two seconds, or focus the aquarium and press Enter or Space.

approval.note: Creator requested Pages deployment and a titled game card in Possibility.
